snippet.title: Tap Tap Goose Promo Trailer
snippet.description:
Tap, flap and fly through an endless obstacle parkour. Save the goose! Simple one tap mechanics, endless levels, endless action, endless fun.

Available on Android, iOS and Crazygames.

https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.byteghoul.goose.escape.action.tap

https://apps.apple.com/app/id1538750194

https://www.crazygames.com/game/tap-tap-goose

Video by Tim Beyer, https://mitrostudios.com
